name: pe-private-link-required
displayName: Platform Engineering - Private Link / no public network access
description: Audits data services that expose public network access so they are reachable only through Private Link / Private Endpoints (retrofitted in Stage 03, ADR-0048). The Storage and PostgreSQL members honor the initiative effect (configurable to Deny once the grace period is over); the Key Vault and Container Registry members are audit-only built-ins with no Deny effect and stay audit-only regardless of the effect parameter. Effects default to Audit at Stage 02 (acceptance criterion 2). Built-in policy GUIDs are pinned and verified against the Azure/azure-policy repository.

metadata.description: Effect for the Storage and PostgreSQL public-network-access controls. Stays at Audit during the Stage 02 grace period; flip to Deny after the exemption inventory is drained (ADR-0011, ADR-0027). The Key Vault and Container Registry members are audit-only built-ins and ignore this parameter.
